description: This file contains functions for serializing Kubernetes runtime objects, specifically handling collection types like lists and unstructured lists, into JSON streams.

methods.name: streamEncodeCollections
methods.description: Encodes a runtime.Object collection into JSON stream, handling UnstructuredList and other list types.

methods.name: getListMeta
methods.description: Extracts list metadata and items from a runtime.Object, with custom logic for JSON serialization compatibility.

methods.name: streamingEncodeList
methods.description: Serializes list metadata and items into JSON format.

methods.name: encodeItemsObjectSlice
methods.description: Encodes a slice of runtime.Object items into JSON array.

methods.name: streamingEncodeUnstructuredList
methods.description: Serializes an UnstructuredList into JSON, including sorting keys and handling 'items'.

methods.name: encodeItemsUnstructuredSlice
methods.description: Encodes a slice of Unstructured items into JSON array.

methods.name: encodeKeyValuePair
methods.description: Encodes a key-value pair into JSON with optional suffix.

methods.name: encodeValue
methods.description: Marshals a value into JSON and writes it to the writer, appending suffix if provided.
